name: trmnl-screenshots
description: Headless-Chromium screenshot tooling and the transform.ts -> transform.js build for the TRMNL Liquid templates. Not part of the plugin runtime itself — trmnl/ is otherwise a trmnlp (Ruby) project; this exists only to render docs/screenshots/*.png from the built HTML in _build/, and to compile the type-safe transform source into the plain JS trmnlp/TRMNL execute.
